query: SELECT t.id, t.reelId, t.status, LENGTH(t.transcript) as transcript_length, LEFT(t.transcript, 80) as preview, sr.userId FROM transcriptions t JOIN saved_reels sr ON sr.reelId = t.reelId ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 10;
